technical_and_design_decisions: Implement each migrated module as a standalone Spring Boot application within the spring-cloud-stream (s-c-s) repository, using the Spring Cloud Stream functional programming model (Supplier for sources, Consumer for sinks) compatible with Spring Framework 6 / Java 17.
Replace Spring XD module APIs with Spring Cloud Stream bindings and Spring Integration endpoints where applicable (e.g., Syslog/TCP inbound/outbound adapters).
Preserve existing core processing logic from XD modules but refactor configuration to use @ConfigurationProperties with standard relaxed binding.
Use Maven multi-module structure consistent with the target s-c-s repo, with each module having its own build and test scope.
For external system sinks (Mongo, HDFS, Greenplum), use supported Spring ecosystem libraries (Spring Data MongoDB, Spring Hadoop, Greenplum JDBC) compatible with the target Java version.
assumptions: The Spring XD source code for the listed modules is accessible and adequately understood by the developer.
The target s-c-s repository already provides base build infrastructure, CI pipelines, and dependency management; only module additions are required.
Migration is purely mechanical/refactoring; no new functional requirements or behavioral changes are expected beyond adapting to the new container.
Integration tests for external dependencies (MongoDB, HDFS, Greenplum) can be executed using Testcontainers or embedded test environments without additional cost for environment provisioning.

Effort estimates cover a single experienced Spring developer performing analysis, coding, testing, and documentation; they exclude external code review iterations, production deployment, and elapsed calendar time.
Mail module is treated as two distinct artifacts: a mail source and a mail sink, as indicated by separate user stories.

activities.activity_description: Set up local JDK 17+ and Maven/Gradle environment, checkout s-c-s repo, study existing module structure and Spring XD source modules to define migration patterns.
Port Spring XD syslog module to s-c-s as a Source (Supplier) using Spring Integration syslog inbound adapter; adapt config and write unit tests.
Port Spring XD mail source module to s-c-s Source, using IMAP/POP3 inbound adapters; update dependencies and tests.
Port Spring XD tcp source module to s-c-s Source using TCP inbound gateway/adapter; handle connection config and tests.
Port Spring XD tcp-client source module to s-c-s Source using outbound client connection pattern; adapt to reactive/blocking model and tests.
Port Spring XD mail sink module to s-c-s Sink (Consumer) using SMTP outbound adapter; adapt config and tests.
Port Spring XD gpfdist sink module (Greenplum parallel file distribution) to s-c-s Sink; integrate Greenplum JDBC/client libraries and write integration tests.
Port Spring XD hdfs-dataset sink module to s-c-s Sink; integrate Spring Hadoop/FileSystem APIs, handle dataset writing and tests.
Port Spring XD mongo sink module to s-c-s Sink using Spring Data MongoDB; adapt repository/reactive templates and tests.
Build all modules together, run integration tests in s-c-s CI context, verify bindings and compatibility, fix issues.
Write module README/metadata, configuration docs, and prepare modules for inclusion in s-c-s release artifact.
